text:
maya: Quick heads-up — quant8 bring-up for redwood-v2-7b is showing a clear spike in hallucination on long prompts (>2k tokens). A few anchor items from the golden set are failing reproducibly.

aiden: Can you paste the eval link?

maya: https://internal.redwood/evals/176987 — summary below. Noticed failures clustered on longctx QA and multi-step reasoning prompts.

maya: ```
model: redwood-v2-7b-quant8
run_id: q8-longctx-2026-04-12
anchor_ids: [anch-114, anch-271, anch-333]
metrics: EM (golden) dropped from 0.92 -> 0.78 on longctx partition
golden_failures: 14/200 (mostly >2k tokens)
```

sam: Any chance these are due to dedupe removing near-duplicates from training but preserving near-duplicates in golden? We recently changed embed-dedupe threshold to 0.82.

maya: Good call. I cross-checked and found samp-9001, samp-9007, samp-9012 are paraphrases that exist in the sampler pool and were de-duped differently across runs. Might be causing distribution mismatch.

priya: Proposal: create a "longctx" stratified bucket in the golden set (size ~50) and freeze it for quant experiments. Also run an IAA pass on the failing anchors.

labeler-bot: New labeling batch created: LB-2026-04-longctx (30 items) assigned to sam, due in 48h.

aiden: For diagnostics, can we run a kernel-fallback eval on the failing anchors? Try attention_v1 fallback to see if it's quant-kernel related.

maya: Ran fallback diagnostic:
```
./eval_tool --model redwood-v2-7b --quant 8 --fallback-kernel attention_v1 --ids anch-114,anch-271
```
Result: fallback recovers expected output for anch-271 but anch-114 still fails (different hallucination). Points to attention chunking + quant sensitivity on some examples.

ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-4312 - quant8 longctx regression (https://issues.redwood/INC-4312).

sam: I'll pause ingestion of new paraphrase-heavy samples from the sampler pool and schedule relabel for LB-2026-04-longctx. Also will re-run embed-dedupe with a temporary softer threshold (0.78) to surface near-paraphrases for manual review.

priya: For the golden update: propose we replace anchors anch-333 and anch-114 with human-reviewed variants that preserve long-context structure, but keep anch-271 unchanged so we can track regressions over time. Thoughts? :thinking: 

aiden: +1 to replacing 2 anchors in the active golden, but keep originals archived in holdout so regression hunting remains possible.

maya: Agreed. I'll add a rollout guard in console: rollback quant8 -> quant4 if EM on golden longctx drops >5% at canary. Added canary config and alert.

labeler-bot: LB-2026-04-longctx progress: 6/30 labeled, current kappa=0.82.

sam: Labels ETA: EOD Wednesday. Will ping when batch completes and push updated golden candidates to the validation queue.

maya: Thanks — once labels are in I can re-run the full regression harness and open a quantization tweak ticket with infra/ops if needed.

priya: Also let's add a small eval that measures prefix-caching mismatch for longctx (prefix lengths 512/1024/2048) — could explain some token alignment errors.

maya: Adding that to the run plan now. Will post results here when available. :eyes:
